title: Ductile Configuration
description: The single schema for ductile configuration — whole config files AND include fragments. The root is deliberately LENIENT: no top-level key is required, so a single-section include file (e.g. just `plugins:` or `webhooks:`) validates on its own, and split sub-objects (webhooks.listen in one file, webhooks.endpoints in another) each validate alone. Every key that IS present is still checked for type, shape, and no-unknown-keys (additionalProperties:false everywhere). Completeness and cross-field rules (e.g. a config must have service/state/plugin_roots; plugins.<name>.parallelism <= service.max_workers) are NOT the JSON Schema's job — they are enforced by the Go loader/doctor at boot. For the strict 'this is a complete, merged config' contract, validate against #/$defs/WholeConfig (config validate --whole).

include.description: Multi-file mode: list of YAML files to merge into this config.

plugin_roots.description: Directories to scan for plugin manifests.

tcc_paths.description: macOS-only: paths stat()-ed on cold start to surface TCC permission popups synchronously.

plugins.description: Per-plugin configuration keyed by plugin name.

pipelines.description: Pipeline definitions (directory-mode pipelines.yaml or inline). The pipeline DSL lives in pipelines.schema.json.

tokens.description: Directory-mode token entries (tokens.yaml). The token entry shape lives in tokens.schema.json.

WholeConfig.description: The strict whole-config contract: a complete, merged config. Adds the top-level completeness requirements that the lenient root deliberately omits so that single include fragments can validate on their own. Validate against this via `config validate --whole` (and, in future, the validate_config_on_boot admission gate).

SecretsConfig.description: Encryption-at-rest settings (age). Encrypted config/token includes are decrypted in memory at load, before ${ENV} interpolation.

age_key_file.description: Path to the age identity (private key) file used to decrypt encrypted includes. Relative paths resolve against the config dir. Overridden by the DUCTILE_AGE_KEY_FILE environment variable. The file must have mode 0600 or load fails. When unset and no default key file exists, encryption at rest is off.

EnvironmentVarsConfig.description: Environment variable file includes for interpolation.

name.description: Service name for logging and identification.

dedupe_ttl.description: Default TTL for job deduplication (Go duration).

job_log_retention.description: How long to retain completed job log entries (Go duration).

job_queue_retention.description: How long to retain terminal job_queue rows (Go duration).

job_transitions_retention.description: How long to retain job state-transition rows (Go duration).

job_attempts_retention.description: How long to retain job attempt rows (Go duration).

breaker_transitions_retention.description: How long to retain circuit-breaker transition rows (Go duration).

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent job workers across all plugins.

plugin_env_passthrough.description: Environment variable names granted to plugin child processes on top of the built-in spawn-hygiene allowlist (PATH, HOME, TZ, LANG, LANGUAGE, LC_* locale categories, TMPDIR). Use sparingly: every name here is one a plugin child sees from the gateway's environment. Secrets should travel over the stdin config map, not here.

strict_mode.description: DEPRECATED bundled admission switch. strict_mode: true is an alias enabling all four admission policies; prefer an explicit service.admission block. When admission is also set, strict_mode is ignored. P2-10.

hook_max_depth.description: Maximum on-hook lifecycle chain depth. A root job that fires a hook produces a depth-1 hook job; if that hook job's plugin also has notify_on_complete: true, its hook is depth 2, and so on. The dispatcher refuses any hook enqueue beyond this cap. 0 means use the built-in default (4). Negative values are rejected. P2-11.

AdmissionConfig.description: The decomplected set of admission-control policies the daemon applies when admitting a config (at boot and reload). Each field is an independent gate; the deprecated strict_mode boolean welded all four together. P2 / decomplect-strict-admission.

verify_integrity_on_boot.description: Run the .checksums + plugin-fingerprint preflight at startup. (Reload always verifies integrity regardless of this flag.)

fail_on_drift.description: Promote operational config/routes drift (otherwise warnings) to admission failures, at both boot and reload.

validate_config_on_boot.description: Require doctor.Validate() to pass at startup.

require_api_auth.description: Reject an enabled API that has no auth tokens configured.

path.description: Path to the SQLite database file (relative to config dir or absolute).

max_concurrent_sync.description: Maximum concurrent synchronous API pipeline executions.

max_sync_timeout.description: Maximum timeout for synchronous pipeline execution (Go duration).

allowed_origins.description: Origins that may receive credentialed CORS headers. Empty (the default) disables cross-origin credential sharing entirely.

APIToken.description: A bearer token with scoped permissions.

uses.description: Alias: use another plugin's implementation by name.

schedules.description: One or more schedule entries for this plugin.

config.description: Plugin-specific configuration passed in the protocol request. May be left empty (null) — it maps to an empty map.

max_outstanding_polls.description: Maximum queued+running poll jobs for this plugin before the scheduler skips.

parallelism.description: Maximum concurrent jobs for this plugin. Runtime validation enforces parallelism <= service.max_workers (cross-field constraint).

notify_on_complete.description: Opt-in to job.completed lifecycle signals for this plugin.

ScheduleConfig.description: Defines when and how a plugin command should be scheduled.

id.description: Unique identifier for this schedule entry (default: 'default').

every.description: Interval schedule: Go duration, extended suffix (3d, 2w), or alias (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly).

after.description: One-shot delay from service start (Go duration).

jitter.description: Random jitter added to schedule interval (Go duration).

catch_up.description: Behavior when the service starts and missed intervals have passed.

if_running.description: Behavior when a schedule fires but a previous job is still running.

only_between.description: Time window constraint (HH:MM-HH:MM). Jobs only fire within this window.

not_on.description: Days to skip. Weekday names (mon, tue) or integers (0=mon, 6=sun, 7=sun).

payload.description: Static payload merged into the protocol request for this schedule.

max_attempts.description: Total attempts including the initial run.

backoff_base.description: Base delay for exponential backoff (Go duration).

TimeoutsConfig.description: Per-command execution timeouts. The four named fields are the core lifecycle commands; any additional key is treated as an operator-defined per-command timeout (e.g. plugins.stress.timeouts.cpu: 15s) and is bound into TimeoutsConfig.Overrides at YAML load (P2-05).

additionalProperties.description: Operator-defined per-command timeout (Go duration). Matched against a plugin manifest command name (e.g. cpu, io).

CircuitBreakerConfig.description: Circuit breaker settings to halt a repeatedly-failing plugin.

threshold.description: Consecutive failures before opening the circuit.

reset_after.description: Duration before a half-open probe is attempted (Go duration).

RelayInstanceConfig.description: A named outbound remote event relay target.

base_url.description: Absolute http or https base URL for the remote Ductile instance.

ingress_path.description: Peer-specific relay ingress path on the receiver.

secret_ref.description: Token entry name containing the shared signing secret.

key_id.description: Optional key rotation identifier sent in X-Ductile-Key-Id.

allow.description: Optional outbound allowlist of relayable event types.

RemoteIngressConfig.description: Inbound trusted peer policy for remote event relay.

listen_path.description: Root path for trusted relay ingress.

require_key_id.description: Require X-Ductile-Key-Id on inbound relay requests.

accept.description: Optional inbound allowlist of accepted event types.

RelayBaggageRules.description: Local policy for admitting remote baggage keys into root-entry context.

WebhooksConfig.description: Webhook listener settings. listen and endpoints may be split across include fragments; the merged config needs both.

plugin.description: Plugin to invoke when this webhook fires.

secret_ref.description: Reference to a shared secret for signature validation.

signature_header.description: HTTP header containing the request signature.
